investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-19T12:26–12:27Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at the /v1/agents endpoint. Because the failure is shared across every sibling check with the exact same error message, the fault is localized to the swarm gateway layer, not to any individual eval or check-specific code path.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB-backed service that the production API proxies agent provisioning requests to — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. Every call to POST /api/agents that requires remote agent provisioning was rejected with HTTP 502 and error code bad_gateway before any agent identity (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) could be established. This is an eval-observed infrastructure availability failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact to production end-users cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.
